description: This file defines a set of React components for a navigation menu UI, utilizing Radix UI primitives and custom styling. It includes components for the menu container, list, items, trigger, content, viewport, links, and indicator, with styling and behavior logic.

methods.name: NavigationMenu
methods.description: Main container component for the navigation menu, rendering Radix UI's Root with optional viewport rendering.

methods.name: NavigationMenuList
methods.description: Component rendering a list of navigation items.

methods.name: NavigationMenuItem
methods.description: Component representing an individual navigation item.

methods.name: NavigationMenuTrigger
methods.description: Component for the trigger button that opens the menu, including an icon indicator.

methods.name: NavigationMenuContent
methods.description: Component for the dropdown content area of the menu.

methods.name: NavigationMenuViewport
methods.description: Component for the viewport area displaying the dropdown menu.

methods.name: NavigationMenuIndicator
methods.description: Component for the visual indicator of the menu's open state.
